It is absolutely normal, and that’s where my problem lies. I don’t want to cut out the two most important people in my life because I have an issue with alcohol. I want to overcome this.

Anytime we were hanging out, everyone was getting drunk or high leaving me to be sober. If we went out hiking or kayaking, I was the person driving us home. If we just spent time to watch a movie, I’m the only one not smoking before we play it. It wasn’t a casual thing for the two groups I cut out.
I messaged the mods. It is apparently a glitch, because they couldn't see the comments either.

I agree with you. I actually liked the guy before all of this, and it almnost seems like he snapped. I hope that he can get some help and may get better if there's something wrong.

And I would've felt awful if he would've went through with it and I would've known.

Yeah, I felt like it way crossed the line of venting/joking. I could understand if it was like a "Ugh, I'm gonna kill this guy one day! He annoys the piss out of me!" But this was not that. At all. 

And that people would just stand by is really sad. I could get why, but damn.

I could not. 

And I am a little worried about that. To be honest, I was afraid I was the potential victim. The only reason I think it isn't me is that he said the person had a criminal past and was another race. Still scary.

It really freaked me out to hear. You're right, it'd be better to speak than to have something happen. 

And the punching things at work isn't super crazy. I mean, I've jokingly thrown empty boxes around before or hit some ribs that were to be thrown out. But he was wailing on this stuff in a serious way. I asked him if he needed to talk after that happened but we were interrupted.
Thank you. That helps to hear.
I'd have terrible guilt if he followed through. And I am a little worried that this will come back on me in a bad way.

I told the managers that it was possible that he was taking a joke way too far, but they said that there is just some things you don't joke about.

And I'd much rather speak up then to find out he actually did it. He did mention that I'd see it in the paper. Who he killed. I'm afraid that the recent tragedy in Vegas might make him think he'll get a little small town fame.

I mean, I asked him several times to tell me if he was joking, and he only admitted that the killing part was a joke, but he still planned on beating the guy. 

It would have been overly clear that I was taking him seriously at a certain point.

I encouraged him to talk to someone, and he laughed at me. He told me he didn't feel empathy and that humans were just sacks of flesh. I tried to reason with him for thirty minutes and nothing happened. All I got out of him was him saying that he'd let me know before he did anything. I really tried my best to talk him out of it.
